en: The long-awaited MG version from "Mobile Suit Gundam"! “Guntank” is finally here with numerous gimmicks! The caterpillar unit is movable by a suspension arm. As a result, action poses with various expressions can be reproduced. The suspension mechanism using plastic parts springs is reproduced inside the caterpillar unit. The console and sensor unit in the head cockpit emit light using the LED unit (2 LR41 button batteries are used, sold separately).The dozer carrier is reproduced in front and behind the lower unit. The caterpillar belt is realistically reproduced by connecting plastic parts. Core fighter is Ganda
